essence: One should visualize a lotus with its seed, stalk, and petals in the middle of that space.
One should visualize the embodied pot together with the previously prescribed meditation.
The teacher, having uttered the Aghora mantra, should worship with offerings beginning with foot-water.
The mixture is combined with cardamom, clove, and the three fruits.
The ritual preparation includes water, milk, kuśa-grass tips, rice grains, flowers, and sesame seeds.
